caption: Fix #1258: a rallying regiment re-squares its ranks where it stands instead of marching the whole block through itself. An 80-man Infantry unit (12 files, so a 7th rank of 8 sits behind six full ranks of 12) starts routing alone, recovers its nerve, and rallies back to IDLE around tick 353-360. Rallying drops the grid fold the flight left behind, which re-squares the block by reflecting it in depth -- and before this fix nothing cancelled that reflection, so every man walked the block's full depth through the oncoming half to reach a slot someone else was vacating in the same tick. State-dumped over ticks 340-540, the two standard demo defects that produced are both gone: mean nearest-neighbour distance now holds at 9.00 (FORMATION_SPACING) throughout instead of collapsing to 1.70, and depth span holds at 54.0 instead of pulsing 54 -> 18 -> 54. Only the four short files step, one rank pitch each, which is the shape change the reform actually exists for.
